question: Which of the following belongs to the first generation of computers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ENIAC**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• **ENIAC (Electronic Numerical Integrator and Computer) was one of the first electronic general-purpose computers.**
 
• It was developed in 1945 and is considered a first-generation computer.
 
• **First-generation computers used vacuum tubes for circuitry and magnetic drums for memory.**
 
• They were large, consumed a lot of power, and were relatively slow.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Napier's Bones:** A manually-operated calculation tool invented in the 17th century.
 
• **Abacus:** An ancient tool for arithmetic calculations, predating computers.
 
• **Pascaline:** An early mechanical calculator invented by Blaise Pascal in the 17th century.
 
• **First-generation computers:** Were characterized by the use of vacuum tubes and were developed during the 1940s and 1950s.
